New-Patient Held-Out Validation (Within Represented Hospitals)

Source: R/profile_validate_holdout_tasks.R
profile_validate_newpatient.Rd

Holds out EVERY event for a selected set of patients entirely from training (refits on the remaining events via profile_fit_joint_bernoulli), then predicts each held-out event using ONLY its covariates – the "unconditional" estimand, i.e. nothing known about that patient's AST results, matching what is actually available for a genuinely new patient at deployment – and scores against whichever classes were actually tested for those events. This is validation WITHIN the hospitals already represented in training; it is NOT leave-one-hospital-out (this family does not implement that as a default task – a hospital's fixed effect is unobserved for an unseen hospital, needing an explicitly different prediction rule/model).

Usage

profile_validate_newpatient(
  Y,
  X,
  ids,
  patient_id,
  output_dir,
  holdout_patient_ids = NULL,
  holdout_fraction = 0.1,
  sampler_config = list(),
  n_draws = 500L,
  seed = 123L
)

Arguments

Y, X, ids

Same as profile_validate_heldout – the FULL (not yet masked/split) data.

patient_id

Character/integer vector, length nrow(Y), in the SAME row order as Y/ids – the patient identifier for every event.

output_dir

Character. Passed to profile_fit_joint_bernoulli for the training-only refit.

holdout_patient_ids

Character/integer vector or NULL. Explicit patient ids to hold out. Default NULL: sampled via holdout_fraction instead.

holdout_fraction

Numeric in (0, 1). Used only when holdout_patient_ids is NULL: this fraction of DISTINCT patients (not events) is sampled for holdout. Default 0.1.

sampler_config

Named list. Passed to profile_fit_joint_bernoulli for the training-only refit.

n_draws, seed

Passed to profile_estimate for the held-out prediction (also the patient-sampling seed, when holdout_patient_ids is NULL).

Value

Named list: predictions, summary, calibration (same shape as profile_validate_masked), refit_result (the training-only fit – check its sampler diagnostics via profile_check_sampler before trusting these scores), n_holdout_events, n_train_events, holdout_patient_ids (echoed, for provenance).
